item.text: {"classifications":[{"segment_id":"1","code":1,"rationale":"The President immediately activates and staffs an internal executive coordinating council, an organizational and staffing action rather than a change to substantive legal rights.","evidence":"to activate immediately the Energy Resources Council, to designate the Secretary of the Interior as its Chairman, and to designate additional officials as members thereof"},{"segment_id":"2","code":1,"rationale":"The President makes a statutory council effective, activates it, and specifies its membership and chairmanship; these are internal executive organization and staffing actions.","evidence":"the Energy Resources Council shall be deemed to have been activated as of that date"},{"segment_id":"3","code":1,"rationale":"The Council is directed to perform its statutorily assigned functions, an internal assignment of executive responsibilities without a dictated legal outcome.","evidence":"shall perform such functions as are assigned to it by section 108 of the Energy Reorganization Act of 1974"},{"segment_id":"4","code":1,"rationale":"The Council must develop a policy and program, but the segment does not prescribe a legally consequential result or itself alter legal rights.","evidence":"shall develop a single national energy policy and program"},{"segment_id":"5","code":1,"rationale":"The provision reserves authority for the President to assign the Council additional functions later without dictating any substantive outcome.","evidence":"shall perform such other functions as may be assigned to it, from time to time, by the President"},{"segment_id":"6","code":1,"rationale":"Departments and agencies are directed to cooperate and share assistance and information within legal limits, which is internal interagency coordination.","evidence":"All departments and agencies shall cooperate with the Council"},{"segment_id":"7","code":1,"rationale":"The segment abolishes one internal executive committee and provides for the statutory termination of another council; both are executive organizational housekeeping.","evidence":"The Committee on Energy, the establishment of which was announced on June 14, 1974, is hereby abolished."}]}
